description: This file defines various React components and types for custom widgets used in a query builder interface, including text, select, multi-select, number, and control components, as well as utility components like Button and Conjs.

methods.name: TextAreaWidget
methods.description: A React component for rendering a textarea input with support for value setting and change handling.

methods.name: TextWidget
methods.description: A React component for rendering a text or number input with change handling.

methods.name: NumberWidget
methods.description: A React component for rendering a number input.

methods.name: MultiSelectWidget
methods.description: A React component for rendering a multi-select dropdown with options filtering.

methods.name: SelectWidget
methods.description: A React component for rendering a single select dropdown with value validation.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A React component for rendering action buttons, including add and delete rule/group buttons.

methods.name: ButtonGroup
methods.description: A React component for grouping multiple buttons.

methods.name: Conjs
methods.description: A React component for selecting conjunction options (All, Any, None) with logic for handling 'not' conditions.

methods.name: FieldSelect
methods.description: A React component for selecting a field from a list of items.

methods.name: Provider
methods.description: A simple wrapper component that renders children.
